text:
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout for service `text-gen` -> v2.14.3 (canary-3). Change window 22:00-23:00 UTC. Canary traffic: 10%. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/backout#text-gen. Backout command: `redwoodctl rollback --service text-gen --to v2.14.2`. Auto-pin policy: if CPU > 90% or p99 latency > 800ms for 3m, auto-pin to last-stable. :rocket:

mai nguyen: ack. I'm on pager and watching the dashboards (grafana link: https://grafana/redwood/text-gen). I'll call it if p99 breaches.

samir: quick Q — if we unpin, how does traffic shift? does deploybot handle gateway routing or do we toggle a feature flag?

deploy-bot: deploybot will update routing. Pin command we use if manual: `deploybot pin text-gen v2.14.2 --reason "canary fail"`. For feature flags, use: `flagctl toggle text-gen enable-optimizer false`.

jordan lee: seeing small bump in p50 but p99 stable so far. No errors on the canary logs (link: https://logs.redwood/text-gen/canary-3).

carol: re-iterating the runbook checklist I have open: 
1) Open incident channel (#incident-text-gen) and add SRE/Release Lead
2) Run `redwoodctl rollback --service text-gen --to v2.14.2` (deploy lead)
3) Pin routing via `deploybot pin ...` (deploybot or ops)
4) Scale down canary pods: `kubectl scale --replicas=0 deploy/text-gen-canary`
5) Clear staging-proxy cache if we see cache-related errors: `redis-cli -h staging-proxy FLUSHDB` (do NOT run global flush)
6) Notify customers + update release notes page
Runbook quick link: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/backout#text-gen-checklist :thumbsup:

samir: metrics to watch: p99 latency (>800ms), error-rate (>1%), model-serving timeouts (grpc 504), and GPU error spikes (OOMs). I'll monitor logs and GPU dashboards.

mai nguyen: adding release notes and tag: https://docs.internal/releases/2026-03-21-text-gen (includes config flag 'enable-optimizer' toggled on in v2.14.3). If rollback happens, we should also revert that flag: `flagctl set enable-optimizer false --env prod`.

release-czar: I'll own customer comms if we roll back. Please ping me once rollback completes and include scope + ETA.

carol: note for Dedicated pools — if we revert model version there is an extra step: `adminctl pool-update --pool text-gen-dedicated --model v2.14.2` (requires infra-admin role). I'm on standby to run that if we need it.

jordan lee: deploybot status: "canary up, 10% traffic, 3 pods". Seeing one transient 502 but no pattern yet.

deploy-bot: Canary scaled to 20% at 22:10 UTC (automated ramp). Monitoring thresholds active.

samir: observed a spike in error-rate to 0.9% at 22:12, p99 still 720ms. Not alarmed yet but watching.

mai nguyen: decision rules we agreed: immediate rollback if error-rate >= 1% sustained for 2m OR p99 >= 800ms sustained for 3m. If near-threshold, hold and investigate for up to 10m, otherwise rollback. Backout lead: carol. Communication lead: release-czar.

carol: I'm ready to execute rollback if thresholds hit. Quick command recap in my notes:
```
# rollback
redwoodctl rollback --service text-gen --to v2.14.2
# pin routing
deploybot pin text-gen v2.14.2 --reason "canary fail"
# revert flag
flagctl set enable-optimizer false --env prod
# scale down canary
kubectl scale --replicas=0 deploy/text-gen-canary
# dedicated pool fix
adminctl pool-update --pool text-gen-dedicated --model v2.14.2
```

samir: copying commands. Also, if cache seems to be the root cause, only flush staging-proxy. If we need a broader cache reset we should coordinate with infra (I'll ping infra).

jordan lee: 22:16 seeing a slight climb, error-rate 1.2% now, p99 820ms (sustained 2m).

mai nguyen: carol, go ahead to rollback now.

carol: running rollback now. Running step 1: `redwoodctl rollback --service text-gen --to v2.14.2` — started.

deploy-bot: Rollback in progress — reverting canary to v2.14.2. Progress: 40% -> 70% -> 100%.

carol: pinned routing to v2.14.2 via `deploybot pin text-gen v2.14.2 --reason "canary error spike"`. Also toggled `enable-optimizer` false.

samir: monitoring — errors dropping, p99 falling. Good signal.

jordan lee: confirmed dedicated pool model reverted. No further 502 spikes.

release-czar: drafting customer message now. ETA for full note ~15m.

mai nguyen: update runbook: adding note to explicitly check the KV proxy logs before flushing global caches. I'll push that change after the incident.

carol: leaving final note: backout executed at 22:20 UTC. Root cause suspected to be optimizer flag interaction with new model variant. Follow-ups: postmortem runbook update, add automated preflight for flag toggle.

deploy-bot: Canary ended (rolled back). Canary traffic: 0%. Service stable on v2.14.2.

jordan lee: thanks everyone. Closing thread after postmortem items are assigned.
